description: This file defines the 'SignalMapper' interface, which handles different types of signals within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It declares a method to map signals to adaptable entities, indicating its role in signal processing and transformation.

classes.name: SignalMapper
classes.description: Interface for handling different types of signals (e.g., thing or policy signals), providing a method to map signals to adaptable entities.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a given signal and channel to an Adaptable object, used during signal processing.
